jd_text:
Deloitte Global is the engine of the Deloitte network. Our professionals reach across disciplines and borders to develop and lead global initiatives. We deliver strategic programs and services that unite our organization.
Work you'll do
 Senior Analyst - Data Modernization & Intelligence (GenAI & Data Lifecycle Focus): This role sits at the intersection of GenAI enablement, data governance, and enterprise M365 platform delivery, supporting global, multi-tenant deployments. The Senior Analyst is responsible for testing, validating, and operationalizing AI-driven capabilities (Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini Enterprise, Claude) while ensuring alignment with data lifecycle management standards and governance controls. 
 * Support the testing, validation, and rollout of GenAI capabilities, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Gemini, and Claude, and related features across collaboration workloads.
 * Evaluate how AI features interact with enterprise data environments, ensuring alignment with data handling, retention, and classification requirements.
 * Execute end-to-end data lifecycle validation, including data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, and output behaviors within M365 and connected systems.
 * Partner with engineering, governance, and platform teams to identify risks, gaps, and inconsistencies in data usage across AI-enabled scenarios.
 * Contribute to controlled testing frameworks, including scenario-based validation, defect tracking, and repeatable test design.
 * Support the development of technical documentation, SOPs, and governance-aligned guidance for AI-enabled capabilities.
 * Provide technical troubleshooting and analysis for issues related to AI feature behavior, data inconsistencies, and platform integration.
 * Perform targeted analysis and reporting to support decision-making, with emphasis on data integrity and trend validation rather than standalone reporting deliverables.
The team
 Deloitte Technology works at the forefront of technology development and processes to support and protect Deloitte around the world. In this truly global environment, we operate not in what is but rather what can be to help Deloitte deliver and connect with its clients, its communities, and one another in ways not previously conceived.
Qualifications
 * Hands-on experience with GenAI tools and platforms, including exposure to enterprise AI capabilities.
 * Strong understanding of data lifecycle management concepts, including data ingestion, processing, storage, access, and retention.
 * Experience with data validation, testing, and quality assurance in enterprise environments.
 * Working knowledge of data governance concepts, including classification, sensitivity, and compliance considerations.
 * Ability to analyze AI-driven outputs and system behaviors, identify inconsistencies, and escalate findings clearly.
 * Experience supporting controlled testing, defect management, and issue tracking workflows.
 * Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to operate in ambiguous, evolving technology environments.
 Preferred/Nice-to-Have 
 * Experience with Microsoft Purview (data governance, compliance, or information protection capabilities).
 * Exposure to multi-tenant or global enterprise environments.
 * Experience supporting AI/ML feature rollout, testing, or evaluation at scale.
 * Scripting or automation experience to support testing or validation workflows.
 * Familiarity with emerging AI tooling (prompt-based systems, AI agents, evaluation frameworks, etc.).
 * Experience translating technical findings into clear, governance-aligned documentation or guidance.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

 Work you'll do
 As a Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities on the Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) Research & Insights (R&I) team, you will be responsible for…
 • Developing research proposals and hypotheses for thought leadership and client briefings focused on the power and utilities and renewable energy industries.

 The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment.  • Programme and enterprise set-up - Defining the organisation’s role, purpose and delivery model; considering internal and external factors such as strategy, programme context, market conditions and supply-chain maturity; and translating these into mobilisation and transition plans.

Connect to your Industry
Do you want to be at the heart of some of the biggest and most ambitious programmes undertaken to keep our country safe?
We are proud of the impact we have with our Defence & Security clients, the strength of our relationships, and the variety of our skills and expertise that we bring to help them achieve their mission.
We’re growing our teams across all of Consulting. If you are cleared to DV level and want to grow your career in this sector, we are very keen to hear from you.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunity
With over 1000 professionals in the UK, our Human Capital practice is renowned for providing distinctive depth and breadth of HR and Organisational Transformation services to clients undertaking complex major programmes and Deloitte is the recognised global leader in HR Consulting, Transformation and Technology with over 300 blue-chip credentials.
Our Human Centered Transformation offering provides clients with the advice and delivery support that they need in their business transformation and technology programmes. Technology adoption consultants are responsible for developing and implementing business change strategies that help users to adoption new technologies solutions. Whether it is planning, supporting, managing or delivering business change activities, we need the very best people to join us and strengthen our team. That is where you come in!
Within the role you will have responsibility for bringing your sector and technical expertise along with broader consulting skills to:
- Help organisation to get maximum value from their investment in technology
- Work closely with stakeholders to ensure that the technology’s usage aligns with the organisation's goals and objectives
- Develop work plans for implementing new technology solutions
- Provide training and support to employees to ensure successful adoption and usage of new technology
- Interact with users to identify potential roadblocks and develop strategies to overcome them
- Measure the success of the adoption process, adjusting as needed
- Assess the organisation's current technology usage and identify areas for improvement
- Stay up-to-date with the best practices, capabilities, and usages of the technology, to ensure the organisation is using the most effective solutions
- Work with a range of stakeholders both internally within Deloitte and in client organisations
- Support business development by contributing to new business proposals and taking roles in industry and account teams
- Contribute to internal practice development by participating in proposition, methodology and point of view development activities and supporting knowledge capture and sharing
Connect to your skills and professional experience
All applicants must hold a DV (Developed Vetting) clearance to apply.
We are currently looking for candidates with proven ability to apply knowledge and expertise in a range of client scenarios, focusing on high quality even in high pressured, time critical situations, and with skills across the following areas:
Technology Adoption
- Proven experience in change management (or equivalent); including leadership alignment, stakeholder identification and analysis, detailed change impact assessment, end-user training, and developing and executing organisational change management plans
- Experience in Hyperscale Cloud Platforms transformation is desirable
- Experience leading and planning training programmes for technology adoption
- Excellent facilitation, communication and data analysis skills
- Experience of managing client relationships, including previous consulting experience
- Strong end-user interaction skills, excellent networking, building working relationships with diverse and cross functional teams
- Ability to handle multiple, conflicting deadlines without compromising on quality
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to multi-task and remain detail orientated
- Experience of leading business development activity in the technology adoption space
Connect to your business - Technology and Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Human Capital
People are what powers enterprise. That’s why we need to focus on the human experience in an ever-changing, digital world. We help clients utilise technology to support their workforce, organisation, and HR Transformations.
Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further details as you progress through the recruitment process, or you can contact the Independence team upon request.
Connect with your colleagues
“The great culture, flexibility, and range of experiences that Deloitte offers is what sets this firm apart. In Human Capital, Deloitte is far ahead of any of our immediate competitors.” - Sophia, Technology and Transformation
Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in Bristol, London, or Manchester with hybrid working.
At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.
Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.
We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.
Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory | Talent standards
Consultant l Deal Transformation & Post Merger Integration l M&A - Commercial Advisory l Jordan
When you work for us, you commit to a career at one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the world. We have received numerous awards over the last few years, including Best Employer in the Middle East, and Best Consulting Firm, and the Middle East Training & Development Excellence Award.
Our Purpose
Deloitte makes an impact that matters. Every day we challenge ourselves to do what matters most—for clients, for our people, and for society. We serve clients distinctively, bringing innovative insights, solving complex challenges, and unlocking sustainable growth. We inspire our talented professionals to deliver outstanding value to clients, providing an exceptional career experience and an inclusive and collaborative culture. We contribute to society, building confidence and trust in the markets, upholding the integrity of organizations, and supporting our communities.
Our shared values guide the way we behave to make a positive, enduring impact:
- Lead the way.
- Serve with integrity.
- Take care of each other
- Foster inclusion
- Collaborate for measurable impact.
Our advisory team provides strategic and financial advisory services to clients throughout all phases of the deal cycle. Financial Advisory in Deloitte comprises several distinct but related global service lines whose shared principal objective is the creation and enhancement of shareholder value. The Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration team supports our clients in solving commercial questions with strategic importance to their business and are particularly focused on matters spanning the entire M&A lifecycle from growth strategy to target screening and due diligence, through integration and separation execution, and beyond.
We are looking for a high-performing person with expertise in Commercial Advisory services. As a Consultant, you will be responsible for working on engagements in M&A strategy, market feasibility study, commercial due diligence, strategy development, business plan review, competition assessment, etc.
Working with professionals in our M&A – Deals team, you will have an opportunity to:
- Prepare, manage, and deliver assignments: typically have day-to-day responsibility for managing small assignments or major modules of larger assignments. This includes liaison with clients and other stakeholders, understanding client issues, defining problem statement, developing hypotheses, structuring the approach and analysis, developing projections & business plans and directing key individuals within the team.
- Develop an approach and conduct the detailed research and analysis to address areas of scope in the engagement, utilising appropriate tools and techniques
- Get involved in business development and marketing activities to initiate and maintain contact with target companies, private equity and other clients.
Leadership Capabilities
- Build own understanding of our purpose and values; explore opportunities for impact.
- Demonstrate strong commitment to personal learning and development; act as a brand ambassador to help attract top talent.
- Understand expectations and demonstrate personal accountability for keeping performance on track.
- Actively focus on developing effective communication and relationship-building skills.
- Understand how their daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and the business.
Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in business (or equivalent experience) with a strong academic track-record.
- Strong subject matter expertise and prior experience in strategy and M&A.
- 2-4 years of relevant work experience e.g. strategy consulting or corporate finance.
- Big 4 / consultancy experience is highly advantageous.
- Microsoft Office proficiency.
- Ability and willingness to travel inside and outside of Egypt on a frequent basis with tight deadlines and demanding client requests.
- Strong written and oral communication skills in English and Arabic.
- Strong analytical capability, structured approach to problem solving, with good commercial acumen, business sense and financial knowledge.
- Self-motivated, and willing to solve challenges and work under pressure.
- High professionalism, and a team player with a positive attitude.
- Ability to meet strict deadlines in high pace and dynamic environment.
#LI-PS1

Job Description & Summary
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Market Access Consultant, you will specialize in providing consulting services focused on pricing strategies and profitability analysis. You will analyze pricing models, assess customer profitability, and offer guidance to help clients optimize pricing strategies, improve profitability, and maximize customer value. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. Within our Commercial & Service Excellence practice, you will have the opportunity to deepen your skills and develop new ones, all while contributing to the growth and success of our clients and the firm.
Responsibilities
Knowledge Preferred 
Candidates should demonstrate substantial experience and/or knowledge in the following areas: 
Payer & Channel Economics: Strong understanding of US payer/channel economics including rebates, chargebacks, 340B, managed care, specialty pharmacy, and government pricing. 
GTN Platforms & Tools: Proven experience with Anaplan model building and administration, especially for use cases such as GTN forecasting, trade spend, or revenue planning. 
GTN & ERP Systems: Experience with related GTN and ERP systems (SAP BRIM, Vistex, Model N, Revitas, iContracts) and analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL). 
Solution Design: Ability to translate business needs into technical design; familiarity with data integrations, model governance, and access controls. 
Skills Preferred 
Candidates should be able to demonstrate extensive delivery abilities within a project team that includes the following: 
Market Access & GTN Delivery 
5-8 years of experience in pricing strategy, market access, or related consulting work 
Prior experience with pharmaceutical companies or top-tier consulting firms is highly desirable 
Develop and validate list-to-net waterfall simulations, accrual true-ups, and price realization analyses 
Lead financial modeling and variance analysis to identify value leakage and recommend improvements 
Analytics & Technology 
Competence in analytical tools, data visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau), and relevant programming languages (preferred) 
Familiarity with data integrations, model governance, and access controls across GTN and ERP systems 
Leadership & Delivery 
Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at senior levels 
Demonstrated success managing cross-functional teams, mentoring staff, and delivering high-impact client outcomes 
Global mindset and ability to work across functions and geographies; comfortable in ambiguous and changing contexts 
Cultivate self-awareness through feedback and reflection; apply critical thinking to bring clarity to ambiguous situations 
Communicate clearly and confidently to influence and connect with others; uphold PwC's code of ethics and business conduct 
What You Must Have
Advanced degree (MBA, MPH, MSc in health economics, pharmacoeconomics, or related) strongly preferred 
Experience with value-based contracts and outcome-based pricing models 
Exposure to launch readiness and lifecycle access planning 
Background contributing to business development, proposals, or thought leadership 
Educational Background 
MBA preferred but not required; candidates with strong academic backgrounds in business, engineering, economics, or data sciences are encouraged to apply 
Advanced degree in health economics, pharmacoeconomics, or a related field is a plus 
What Sets You Apart
Experience in pricing strategy, market access, or related consulting work; prior experience with pharmaceutical companies or top-tier consulting firms is highly desirable

Up to 40%

Job Profile: Payer Modernization – Healthcare Transformation & Analytics
Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
• Healthcare Back Office Transformation
• Healthcare Middle Office Transformation

• Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
• Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
• Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.

• Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
• Experience working with complex datasets.
• Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience
• Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
• Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
• Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
• Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
• Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
• Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
• Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
• Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
• Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.

Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.

• Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
• Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
• Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
• Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.

• Providing operational due diligence on both the buy and sell side of a transaction.
• Identifying or reviewing synergies available as the result of a transaction and assessing plans for their realisation.
• Supporting divestment of subsidiary businesses and planning to ensure the carved-out entity can continue to operate on day 1.
• Assisting the purchaser with 100 day planning, taking control of the new entity and delivering quick wins.
• Supporting our clients on the integration of their acquisition, in order to deliver the value identified pre-deal, reduce risk and successfully merge the two organisations.

Job Description & Summary
PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement. 
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences. 
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble. 
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Au sein de notre entité Consulting, l’équipe CIO Advisory (100 collaborateurs) adresse les 3 enjeux majeurs des DSI et des directions de la Transformation de grands groupes internationaux et d’entreprises de taille intermédiaire en pleine croissance :
• Stratégie SI : imaginer et bâtir le SI du futur, créateur de valeur pérenne, aligné avec la stratégie de l’entreprise, sobre, plus urbanisé et catalysé par l’intelligence artificielle
Schémas directeurs SI-Métiers et Technologiques, Architecture SI / Cloud, Plan Stratégique IT, Green IT / IT-for-Green …
• Transformation de la filière informatique : adapter l’organisation et les modes de fonctionnement de la DSI (Support, Informatique et Coeur de métier) pour y intégrer au mieux les enjeux technologiques
Modèles opérationnels IT cibles, excellence opérationnelle, performance opérationnelle et économique de la DSI …
• Cadrage et pilotage des transformations SI / Métier : réussir l’exécution des transformations pour concrétiser le B-case
Gouvernance, structuration, sécurisation des choix technologiques, refonte de processus métier, accompagnement de programmes ERP…
Ce que vous pouvez attendre de nous
• Appuyer les comités de direction dans leur réflexion stratégique en intégrant toutes les dimensions d’une transformation (métier, technologique, data, process)
• Co-construire leur feuille de route et aligner les différents métiers de l’entreprise
• Repenser / optimiser les processus métiers
• Faire les bons choix de solutions, partenaires et de gouvernance
• Aligner la filière informatique aux besoins de transformation
• Structurer et piloter les projets de transformation dans une approche création de valeur et de maîtrise des risques
Ce que nous attendons de vous
• Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d’un 3ème cycle universitaire
• Vous avez une forte appétence pour la technologie
• Vous souhaitez décliner la technologie au service des métiers
• Vous avez de très bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse
• Vous êtes capable de vous intégrer dans une équipe dynamique et d’y apporter votre contribution : aide à la rédaction de propositions commerciales, structuration et formalisation de livrables, etc.
• Vous maîtrisez l’anglais pour travailler avec nos équipes et clients à l’international.
Ces avantages que nous vous offrons : 
• Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain. 
• Des possibilités d’apprentissage et de développement hors normes, grâce à notre plateforme de formation intelligente et notre culture du feedback continu. 
• Un cycle de performance stimulant, aligné avec le référentiel PwC Professional, pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs et viser l’excellence jour après jour.
• Un cadre de travail positif et inclusif pour vous permettre d’être pleinement vous-même et de collaborer efficacement au service de nos clients (programmes de parentalité, d’équité femmes-hommes, de santé et bien-être Be Well, Work Well, d’inclusion LGBT+ et de maintien dans l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap). 
Pour en savoir plus sur nos avantages, rendez-vous sur notre page dédiée.
Notre processus de recrutement 
Pour vous permettre de vivre une expérience fluide et transparente, notre processus de recrutement se déroule en plusieurs étapes : 
• Évaluation en ligne avec un test de compétences et/ou un test d’anglais 
• Entretien RH 
• Rencontres avec les équipes opérationnelles (un ou plusieurs entretiens en physique) 
• Vérification des informations : avant l’embauche, un organisme spécialisé procédera à la vérification des éléments figurant sur votre CV

To know more about our community please visit: https://www.pwc.lu/en/people-organisation.html 
Within the HR Technology & Transformation team, we place people at the heart of every transformation. Our work goes beyond system implementation: we help organisations create more transparent, efficient and human‑centred HR experiences. By co‑creating and co‑innovating with our clients, we design digital HR solutions that genuinely empower employees and support better decision‑making. 
As part of the projects you will be working on, your role will move fluidly between supporting HR platforms implementation and rethinking HR processes, supporting HR projects rollout (such as payroll implementations, pay transparency projects, strategic workforce planning initiatives, change management support, etc.). If you enjoy variety and to expand your HR expertise – this is built for you. 
Be a part of our team where you will: 
HR systems & technology 
• Guide clients in choosing, implementing and improving their HR systems, broaden your expertise across HR technologies and emerging digital HR trends such as AI‑enabled tools, and advanced analytics;
• Lead or co‑lead functional modules during HR systems implementations (HCM, recruitment and onboarding, absence, etc), participating in activities such as requirements gathering, process design, configuration, testing cycles, data validation and training. Progressively and in line with your previous experience, you will be trusted to make recommendations, challenge the status quo and drive initiatives that raise quality and efficiency;
• Support all phases of testing (UAT, E2E, regression), prepare test scripts, and coordinate feedback with client teams;

• Bring an HR practitioner's eye to client challenges: spot what's not working in a process, not just in a tool;

• Spot opportunities and bring fresh ideas in how we go‑to‑market.

• Possess advanced MS Office skills, especially Excel;
• Are curious about Generative AI, automation and next‑generation digital HR - you like trying new tools and following where AI and analytics are taking HR;
• Are able to work autonomously, learn quickly and bring fresh ideas;
• Are fluent in English and French and have a natural ease building relationships with clients and colleagues. 
…You are the candidate we are looking for! 
If you want HR expertise, technology and a bit of innovation to all be part of your day-to-day, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description & Summary
Contribute to creating a better tomorrow 
The only way we can tackle the challenges of this fast-changing world is with passionate people. Led by our purpose of building trust and solving important problems, we come together at PwC to address the biggest issues facing the world in a way that drives positive impact. Are you eager to join a team fueled by open and curious minds? People who are passionate about their work and create new solutions for a new day? Then you’re in the right place. 
Bring your talent. Learn new skills. Make a positive impact 
PwC Advisory is a network of multiple possibilities - where you want to make an impact is always up to you. Under the expert stewardship of our Advisory experts, you’ll delve into the inner workings of companies to find the best solutions for any challenge they might have.
From the excitement of deals to the complexities of consulting and the fascinating realm of risks and threats in forensics, you’ll help clients nurture trust and maintain their evolutionary edge, today and into the future. Now that’s making a difference. 
Do you want to be part of our PwC Pharma & Life Sciences (PLS) team & practice?
PwC is looking for a talented professional with experience in PLS business consultancy to join our PwC Management Consulting department. You will join a team tackling complex challenges spanning clinical development, business operations, quality, and value-based health care. Our strategy is to build trust, deliver sustained outcomes and help clients solve their most important problems by combining human ingenuity and understanding with the right technology. First, you’ll manage R&D or Quality projects at Pharma or Biotech clients, including strategic assessment, developing recommendations and implementation of new operating models. Second, you’ll actively contribute to the development of PwC center of excellence. This means contributing to business development activities including service offering, scanning of the market and account planning, and supporting market development activities including writing thought leadership, point-of-view papers and/or blog posts. 
What you’ll learn and do
As a Senior Consultant Research & Development, your main responsibility will be on any or a combination of the following activities:
• Strategic Advising: Providing strategic advice to pharmaceutical and life sciences companies and the healthcare sector to enhance their R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare initiatives. This can involve evaluating current R&D, Quality and/or value-based healthcare practices and recommending improvements.
• Process Optimization: Identifying inefficiencies in the R&D pipeline and Quality processes and suggesting process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce time-to-market for new drugs and therapies.
• Technology implementation & innovation Management: Assisting clients by managing their innovation processes through identifying opportunities for drug development and adopting new technologies. This could include implementing efficiencies and enhancing quality processes through technology. As well as, supporting clients by generating insights on ways to improve care pathways and work on enhancing organizational readiness for value-based healthcare.
• Data Analysis and Insights: Analysing data to provide insights that can drive decision-making in health industry and healthcare projects. This involves leveraging advanced analytics and digital tools.
• Project Management: Leading and managing projects, ensuring they are delivered on time and within budget while meeting client expectations. Identify and mitigate risks to ensure successful outcomes.
• Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Facilitating collaboration among various stakeholders, including researchers, healthcare providers and professionals, regulatory bodies, third party payers and authorities, and (other business units in) industry (pharma, medtech, biotech, data/digital), to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes.
• Change Management: Supporting clients in managing the organizational changes that come with implementing new R&D & Quality strategies or technologies, and transformation efforts towards value-based healthcare principles.
Who you are:
• Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, (health) economics, (bio-)engineering, business administration, sciences or comparable by experience 
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in consultancy and/or the Life Science industry
• Knowledge of (pre-)clinical regulations as well as quality and risk management.
• Know-how and interest in trends (science/data/digital) within Life Science & Healthcare industry 
• Ability to combine specialist technical knowledge, strong analytical and problem-solving skills with consulting skills (project management, presentation and communication skills, etc.) while working directly with management and employees on the clients’ premises 
• Fluent in English, and Dutch or French 
• Flexibility to work in different environments and locations and easily acquire new skills and expertise
• Autonomous and proactive attitude with an entrepreneurship mindset.
Life at PwC Belgium
Our culture and workplace are something we’re proud of. Here’s a sneak peek at what life at PwC looks like:
• Flexible work patterns: Achieve the perfect balance between office and home life with our flexible hybrid work arrangements and family-friendly schemes.
• Lifelong learning: Grow with us! Take advantage of our diverse training opportunities and exciting career pathways to explore new disciplines and expertise.
• Flexible rewards: Tailor your benefits to suit your lifestyle with our customizable rewards plan.
• Sustainable mobility: Choose eco-friendly mobility options, from our soon-to-be fully electrified fleet to public transport, shared cars, ebikes, and more.
• Inclusive culture: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive workplace that values and celebrates every individual's contributions.
• Wellbeing focus: Enjoy a positive environment with our comprehensive wellbeing programs, engaging sports communities, and confidential support for all your professional and personal challenges.
• Global network: Expand your horizons with opportunities to work abroad and tap into extensive industry expertise within the PwC network.
Let’s build something great together. What are you waiting for?

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance.
As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
The Opportunity: 
As a Digital Operations, Senior Associate, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. You will work closely with Managers and senior team members to translate planning and readiness questions into analytical outputs that inform decision‑making. The role emphasizes strong analytical execution, clear communication of results, and an interest in how analytics is used in real operational decisions. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to: 
Analytical Problem Solving 
• Support structuring of operational, logistics, and planning challenges as analytical problems under uncertainty. 
• Contribute to analysis of trade‑offs involving capacity, inventory, risk, service levels, and timing. 
• Apply quantitative techniques with appropriate rigor based on guidance from senior team members. 
Applied Modelling & Analysis 
• Build and support quantitative analyses including Supply chain network and flow analysis, Inventory planning under uncertainty, Capacity, throughput, and bottleneck analysis, Scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation 
• Support model testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to ensure outputs are reliable and decision‑relevant. 
Technology & Tools 
• Develop and maintain analytics code, models, and supporting documentation. 
• Work with data from multiple systems and sources. 
• Support documentation of business rules, data requirements, process flows, and reporting logic. 
• Tools may include Python, R, and SQL; optimization solvers; simulation libraries; and enterprise or cloud data platforms. 
• Follow governed, auditable analytics and documentation practices. 
Team & Stakeholder Support 
• Work collaboratively within project teams to deliver high‑quality analytical outputs. 
• Support preparation of materials and insights for client discussions. 
• Proactively flag data, modelling, or assumption risks to senior team members. 
• Work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. 
What You'll Bring: 
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:
• Degree in operations, industrial/systems engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field. 
• A minimum of 5 years of experience in a relevant field. 
• Experience applying quantitative or analytical techniques to operations, supply chain, or planning problems in defense, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries. 
• Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to data quality and assumptions. 
• Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, and digital workflow enablement is an asset. 
• Candidates with military experience are encouraged to apply 
• PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer.

• As a requirement, a Security Clearance is mandatory for all staff who’ll be engaged on these assignments. Prior to applying, please review the Government of Canada website to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements to obtain this clearance. This’ll become a condition of your employment with PwC should you receive an offer from us. 
• Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for non‑technical audiences. 
This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.
The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Es werden die sein, die Technologie und menschliche Stärken am besten verbinden. In unserem Team Customer Transformation begleiten wir führende Unternehmen auf diesem Weg. Wir bauen kundennahe Wertströme in Marketing, Vertrieb und Service end-to-end neu auf: von der Strategie über das Zielbild bis zur Umsetzung.
Dabei erleben wir gerade einen grundlegenden Shift. CRM-Plattformen öffnen sich nach dem Headless-Prinzip, Frontends werden entkoppelt. Die Customer Journey findet zunehmend dort statt, wo Menschen ohnehin arbeiten und fragen: in KI-Assistenten und Agenten-Plattformen wie Claude oder ChatGPT. Deshalb arbeiten wir technologieoffen: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Nutzen für unsere Kund:innen, nicht das Tool. Unser Partner-Ökosystem wächst laufend.
Bei uns bist du nicht nur Teil eines Projekts. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein Thema und treibst es voran.

• Gestalte gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen die Transformation zum Agentic Enterprise in Marketing, Sales und Service 
• Begleite unsere Kund:innen beim Wandel hin zu Headless- und agentischen Architekturen und arbeite an zukunftsfähigen Customer Journeys 
• Entwickle Zielbilder, Use Cases und Roadmaps und übersetze komplexe Fragestellungen in klare Konzepte und greifbare Business Cases 
• Übernimm Verantwortung von der Kundenakquise über die Angebotserstellung bis zur erfolgreichen Projektdurchführung 
• Konzipiere und moderiere Workshops mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management und begeistere Stakeholder bis auf Entscheider-Ebene für neue Wege 
• Verbinde Business und Technologie, bewerte Technologie-Optionen unabhängig und begleite die konzeptionelle Gestaltung und Umsetzung agentischer Lösungen 
• Unterstütze unsere Kund:innen bei Change, Adoption und Governance, damit die Transformation im Alltag ankommt 
• Treibe Themen aktiv voran und entwickle unser Leistungsportfolio und Partner-Ökosystem rund um Agentic Enterprise gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter

• Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten Technologie und Neugier auf die anderen, zum Beispiel: • KI-Modelle & Agenten-Plattformen: z. B. Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI / ChatGPT, Google Cloud (Gemini, Vertex AI), AWS (z. B. Amazon Bedrock)

• Spezialisierte KI-Lösungen: z. B. Voice-AI und KI-Telefonie (etwa fonio)

Kia ora, 
At PwC, our purpose is clear: to build trust in society and solve important problems. 
This is a place to keep growing. You’ll learn from the best, take on meaningful challenges, and make a lasting impact for our clients, our communities, and Aotearoa. 
Ngā kōrero mo tēnei tūranga / About the role 
We are looking for a Senior Analyst to join PwC’s Transformation Design & Delivery team, with particular focus on business analysis and business process improvement across transformation programmes. 
This opportunity is suited to someone who enjoys understanding how organisations work, identifying where processes can be improved, and helping clients translate complex business needs into clear, practical solutions. 
You’ll work alongside experienced transformation professionals across a range of client engagements, taking ownership of business analysis and process improvement activities across complex business and technology change. 
You’ll use PwC-approved AI-enabled tools to enhance how you work and help clients explore how AI, automation and emerging technologies can improve business processes and ways of working; helping clients understand their current state, define future ways of working and translate requirements into practical actions that support successful transformation outcomes.
Responsibilities will include: 
• Gather, analyse and document business requirements, translating complex information into clear, practical recommendations and actions. 
• Map current-state processes and help design improved future-state processes, ways of working and supporting documentation. 
• Plan and facilitate workshops and stakeholder sessions to gather information, validate requirements and build alignment. 
• Develop key transformation deliverables, including process maps, requirements documentation, user journeys and operating procedures. 
• Identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and emerging technologies in the design of future-state processes and ways of working, helping clients improve operational efficiency and customer and employee experiences. 
• Identify process gaps, risks and dependencies, and support testing, implementation and transition activities. 
• Take ownership of defined pieces of work and contribute to the successful delivery of broader transformation workstreams. 
• Contribute to PwC’s transformation tools, frameworks and ways of working while continuing to build your consulting and delivery capability.
Ngā pūkenga ka kawea mai e koe, ka whakawhanakehia rānei i tēnei tūranga / Skills you will bring or develop in this role
• 2+ years’ experience in business analysis, business process improvement, transformation, change or project-based environments. 
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to understand complex business problems and break them down into clear requirements and practical solutions. 
• Experience gathering, analysing and documenting business requirements through interviews, workshops, and stakeholder engagement. 
• Exposure to business process mapping, process improvement, and current-state / future-state analysis. 
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across different teams and levels of an organisation. 
• Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to translate complex information into practical and easy-to-understand outputs. 
• Comfortable working across business and technology teams and connecting operational needs with wider transformation objectives. 
• A keen interest in AI, automation and emerging technologies, with experience using or a willingness to learn AI-enabled tools to improve business analysis, problem-solving and ways of working. 
• Well-organised and proactive, with the ability to manage competing priorities, take ownership of deliverables and contribute across multiple workstreams. 
• Previous consulting experience would be advantageous.

Job Description & Summary
Kā vecākais konsultants Tu piedalīsies stratēģiski svarīgu projektu īstenošanā sadarbībā ar Latvijas publiskās pārvaldes iestādēm, pašvaldībām, kapitālsabiedrībām un Eiropas Savienības institūcijām. Kopā ar projekta komandu Tu izstrādāsi stratēģijas, novērtēsi organizāciju un procesu efektivitāti, kā arī ieviesīsi pārmaiņas.​
Ko Tu darīsi?​
• Piedalīsies konsultāciju projektu īstenošanā un/vai patstāvīgi vadīsi projekta komandu 2-5 cilvēku sastāvā. ​
• Konsultāciju projekta ietvaros būs jāveic:​
• informācijas izpēte, apkopošana, datu analīze un vizualizēšana; ​
• intervijas, anketēšana, procesu kartēšana un koprades darbnīcas;​
• ziņojuma gatavošana.​
• Gatavosi piedāvājumus publiskā sektora un starptautisko organizāciju klientiem;​
• Veidosi un uzturēsi attiecības ar esošajiem un jaunajiem klientiem.​ ​​​
Par Tevi:​
• Obligāta pieredze pieredze konsultāciju jomā - analītiska darba veikšanā, t.sk. informācijas izpētē, datu analīzē un pētījumu ziņojumu sagatavošanā;
• Vēlama pieredze projektu vadībā, stratēģiju, procedūru aprakstu izstrādē.​
• Augstākā izglītība; ​
• Ļoti labas latviešu un angļu valodas prasmes, kas ir nepieciešamas veiksmīgai darbībai starptautiskā vidē, saziņai un sadarbībai ar ārvalstu kolēģiem un klientiem;​
• Proaktivitāte un orientācija uz rezultātu; ​
• Motivācija tiekties uz profesionālu izaugsmi un iegūt jaunas zināšanas.​
​
Ko Tu iegūsi, pievienojoties PwC Latvija komandai?​
• Atbalstoša, draudzīga un uz sadarbību vērsta komanda;​
• Iespēja sadarbībā ar starptautiskām institūcijām strādāt pie Latvijai stratēģiski nozīmīgiem projektiem;​
• Ikgadēja atalgojuma pārskatīšana, bonusu programma, papildus ikgadējā atvaļinājuma dienas un prombūtnes dienas nozīmīgos dzīves notikumos; ​
• Individuāli radīts attīstības plāns Tavai profesionālajai izaugsmei un pieredzējis mentors Tev līdzās;​
• Iespēja attīstīt savas profesionālās prasmes caur dažādiem semināriem vietējā un starptautiskā mērogā, kā arī caur e-apmācībām;​
• Apmaksāts sertifikācijas process (PRINCE2, PMP, CFA, u.c.);​
• Pievilcīgs labumu grozs pēc pārbaudes laika beigām (veselības apdrošināšana, 3. pensiju līmenis, budžets ēdināšanas vai sporta/veselības pakalpojumiem);​
• Iespēja strādāt arī attālināti (hibrīda modelī);​
• Regulāras komandas saliedēšanās aktivitātes un labbūtības iniciatīvas;​
• Atalgojums no 1900 līdz 3000 EUR (bruto) mēnesī atkarībā no kandidātam piemītošajām kompetencēm.​ ​

Line of Service Overview
Our Deals practice helps clients create, capture, and deliver value through mergers and acquisitions, restructuring, and strategic investments. We provide end-to-end advisory services, combining deep industry knowledge with technical expertise to support clients in achieving their growth and transformation objectives. 
Business Unit Overview
The Deals Strategy & Operations (DSO) team delivers strategic, commercial, and operational insights to corporates, private equity firms, family offices, and government entities. We advise on investment and divestment decisions, evaluate business plans, and address critical operational and transformational challenges to help clients achieve sustainable outcomes. 
How You’ll Contribute
As a DSO Senior Associate supporting Healthcare and Pharma, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 
• Conduct feasibility studies, commercial due diligence, market assessments, and growth strategies for healthcare and pharma clients 
• Structure analysis and apply strategic frameworks to solve client problems and develop actionable recommendations 
• Take ownership of engagement components and collaborate with team members to deliver high-quality reports and presentations 
• Research, aggregate, and analyse data to extract insights and support strategic decision-making

• Support internal business development activities and contribute to proposals and thought leadership 
• Actively participate in client engagements, working closely with Managers and Senior Managers 
What You’ll Bring
• 3+ years of relevant experience in M&A, strategy consulting, or corporate finance, preferably within healthcare or pharmaceuticals 
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field; a master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CFA) is a plus 
• Strong understanding of feasibility studies, market research, and business plan development 
• Experience conducting commercial due diligence and strategic assessments for large organisations 
• Excellent analytical skills and ability to synthesise complex information into clear insights 
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint 
• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to deliver messages effectively to diverse audiences 
• Arabic language skills are an advantage 
• Your flexibility to travel 20%–40% of the time. This means we may require you to work away from your base office location on a regular basis and frequent overnight stays may be required. Where possible, we will take your preferences into account and strike a balance between meeting your career development/personal needs and those of the business and our clients

At PwC Middle East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level. 
Why You’ll Love Working at PwC
At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job – you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

jd_text:
Wer wir sind
Unser Strategy& Energy, Utilities & Resources (EUR) Deals Team begleitet führende Unternehmen und Investoren bei strategischen Fragestellungen und Transaktionen rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Strategien, bewerten neue Märkte und Geschäftsmodelle und identifizieren konkrete Wertsteigerungs- und Wachstumspotenziale. Unsere Projekte reichen von Commercial (Vendor) Due Diligence und Value Creation über Corporate und Growth Strategy bis hin zu Go-to-Market, Internationalisierung und Business Model Development.
Inhaltlich arbeiten wir entlang zentraler Felder der Energiewende, darunter erneuerbare Energien, Batteriespeicher und andere Flexibilitätslösungen, Stromnetze und Smart Metering, Elektrifizierung von Wärme und Industrie sowie neue digitale und softwarebasierte Geschäftsmodelle. Dabei arbeiten wir sowohl mit PE- und Infrastrukturinvestoren als auch mit Utilities, Entwicklern, IPPs, Technologie- und Serviceanbietern. 
Du wirst Teil eines interdisziplinären Teams aus Expert:innen verschiedenster Fachrichtungen – von Ingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Geologie bis zu Naturwissenschaften. Viele Teammitglieder bringen zudem wertvolle Erfahrungen aus der Industrie, Startups oder anderen Beratungen mit. Neben abwechslungsreichen Projekten sorgen regelmäßige Team-Events, gemeinsame Trainings und eine offene Unternehmenskultur für starken Teamspirit und Spaß bei der Arbeit.
Was du bei uns bewegen wirst
Als Senior Associate (w/m/d) im Bereich Energy und Deals spielst du eine wesentliche Rolle bei der Beratung führender Unternehmen und Investoren rund um die Energiewende und das zukünftige Energiesystem. Deine Projekte reichen von Commercial (Vendor) Due Diligence und Value Creation bis hin zu Wachstumsstrategien und neuen Geschäftsmodellen. Inhaltlich beschäftigst du dich unter anderem mit erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichern und Flexibilität, Stromnetzen sowie der Elektrifizierung von Wärme und Industrie. Mit deiner strategischen Expertise übernimmst du die Leitung einzelner Workstreams für komplexe Projekte und schlüpfst mit Leidenschaft in eine Mentor:innenrolle für deine Kolleg:innen. 
Du arbeitest dich intensiv in komplexe Fragestellungen unserer Klient:innen ein, führst unabhängige Analysen durch, definierst Problemstellungen und gestaltest Strategien, die für den Erfolg unserer Klient:innen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind.
Im Rahmen des Onboardings erlernst du grundlegende Methoden und Techniken eine:r Strategieberater:in und entwickelst dich mit jedem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Projekt zu einem bzw. einer echten Expert:in im Bereich Energy mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien und Deals.
Als Teil unseres Consulting-Teams analysierst du heute schon die Probleme von morgen und entwickelst Strategien für die frühzeitige Realisierung von Transformationen unserer Klient:innen. Dabei profitierst du von unserem weltweiten Expert:innenteam aller Disziplinen innerhalb des PwC-Netzwerks, auf das du für die Umsetzung zurückgreifen kannst.
Was du mitbringst
Universitätsabschluss mit Top-Leistungen: Dein Studium (inkl. Master/Diplom, MBA oder PhD) in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik, Ingenieurwissenschaften, Naturwissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-) Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet hast du mit exzellenten Leistungen abgeschlossen. 
Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst erste Berufserfahrung aus einer Top-Managementberatung oder spezialisierten Boutique-Beratung im Bereich Energie (Schwerpunkt Energiewende) und funktionaler Expertise im Bereich Deals (Schwerpunkt Commercial Due Diligence und Value Creation) mit.
Auslandserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du im Rahmen deines Studiums, Praktika oder durch Tätigkeiten im Ausland internationale (Berufs-)Erfahrung gesammelt. 
Exzellenter Kommunikationsstil: Dich zeichnet eine außergewöhnlich hohe Kommunikationsstärke in sowohl deutscher als auch englischer Sprache aus. Es macht dir Spaß, gemeinsam im Team Ergebnisse aufzubereiten und sie vor unseren (inter-) nationalen Klient:innen zu präsentieren.
Ausgeprägte Handlungs- und Methodenkompetenz: Durch deine hervorragenden analytischen Fähigkeiten fällt es dir leicht, komplexe Sachverhalte zu strukturieren, Probleme zu identifizieren und daraus strategische Lösungsansätze für die größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit abzuleiten. Deine Kenntnisse im Umgang mit gängigen Tools, wie zum Beispiel Excel sowie Programmierkenntnisse, sind dabei hilfreich.
Was wir dir bieten
Mentoring: Im Rahmen unseres Mentoring-Programms steht dir ein:e Mentor:in für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung zur Seite. 
Trainings: Für jedes Level deiner Karriere bieten wir dir ein Set an spezifischen Trainings an. Darüber hinaus kannst du auf ein internationales Trainingsangebot aus dem PwC-Netzwerk zurückgreifen. 
Offsite-Events: Bei uns gibt es viele Gelegenheiten, gemeinsame Erfolge zu feiern. Zum Beispiel im Rahmen von Projekt-Team-Events, bei unseren jährlichen Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern oder dem internationalen Strategy& Soccer Cup. 
Top-Strategieberatung: Wir leben eine Kultur des starken Zusammenhalts und der familiären Atmosphäre. Das spiegelt sich in den Rankings wie Vault oder Bewertungen auf Kununu wider. 
Hohes Maß an Flexibilität: Im Rahmen eines Flex Work Programms hast du in Absprache mit deinem Team die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeit- und -ort variabel zu gestalten. 
Weitere Benefits: Bei Strategy& genießt du je nach aktuell gültigem Benefit-Programm zahlreiche Vorteile aus dem PwC-Netzwerk, wie zum Beispiel Familienservice, Versicherungen, Betriebskrankenkasse, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und viele Vergünstigungen im Online- und Einzelhandel.
Hast du Lust auf inspirierende Themen und eine steile Lernkurve? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
Bitte nenne uns auch deinen präferierten Einstiegstermin.

jd_text:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Senior Consultant, Learning Transformation | Financial Services
Help Shape the Future of Learning in Financial Services
At EY People Consulting, we help leading banking, insurance, and wealth and asset management organisations transform how their people learn, grow and perform.
As organisations navigate regulatory change, digital transformation and evolving workforce expectations, learning is increasingly becoming a strategic driver of business success. We're looking for a Senior Consultant to join our growing Financial Services Learning team and help clients build the skills, capabilities and behaviours needed for the future.
This is an exciting opportunity to work alongside experienced consultants and industry specialists, delivering innovative learning and transformation solutions for some of the world's most recognised financial services organisations.
What You'll Do
As a Senior Consultant, you'll play a key role in delivering complex client engagements while building trusted stakeholder relationships and contributing to the growth of our practice.
You will:
• Lead the delivery of workstreams across learning transformation and capability development programmes within financial services.
• Partner with clients to develop innovative learning strategies and capability solutions.
• Support the design and delivery of innovative learning and capability solutions tailored to client needs.
• Support the development of strong client relationships, working closely with stakeholders to understand business priorities.
• Contribute to business development activities, including proposal and proposition development and client pursuits.
• Contribute to engagement delivery, operations and risk management activities.
• Support wider People Consulting initiatives through knowledge sharing and practice growth activities.
With a specific focus on Learning & Development, you will:
• Support development of learning strategies aligned to workforce capability needs and learning technologies.
• Design, develop and deploy impactful learning solutions across digital and non-digital formats.
• Contribute to the design of learning strategies, capability frameworks, curricula and learning journeys that address current and future workforce needs.
• Support organisational transformation and behavioural change through learning initiatives and analytics.
• Contribute to proposal development, solution design and client presentations.
• Help develop EY's learning offerings and contribute to the ongoing growth of the practice.
• Drive innovation and bring fresh thinking to create market-leading learning solutions and thought leadership.
What We're Looking For
Essential Experience
• Consulting experience gained within professional services, consulting, or large-scale in-house transformation environments.
• Experience supporting change and transformation programmes, ideally with a learning or capability focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills with experience working across diverse groups to deliver successful outcomes.
• Strong project management, communication and presentation skills.
• Experience producing high-quality analysis, reports and client-ready deliverables.
• Experience working within financial services, including banking, insurance, and/or wealth and asset management.
Skills & Attributes
• Strong consulting and influencing skills with the ability to build credibility with stakeholders.
• Passion for learning, capability development and helping organisations perform at their best.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive, solutions-focused approach.
• Curiosity, innovation and a desire to challenge the status quo.
• Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced environments.
• Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on practical, sustainable outcomes.
Ideally, You'll Also Have
• A relevant degree and/or professional qualification.
Why EY?
You'll join a fast-growing, collaborative team that combines learning expertise, behavioural science and deep financial services knowledge to solve complex people challenges.
In return, you'll have the opportunity to:
• Work with some of the world's leading financial services organisations.
• Deliver high-profile transformation and learning programmes.
• Develop consulting, client leadership and business development skills.
• Collaborate with experts across EY's global network.
• Accelerate your career in a supportive, high-performing team.
• Benefit from flexible working, continuous development and a competitive rewards package.
At EY, we're building a better working world by putting people at the heart of transformation. Join us and help shape the future of learning in financial services.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jd_text:
Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. 
EY Studio+ réunit les expertises d’EY en design et stratégie d’innovation, technologie, marketing et expérience client pour créer des solutions intégrées et transformer de bout en bout la relation client. Ses équipes pluridisciplinaires — soutenues par 600 talents en France (parmi les 7000 du réseau EY Global) — combinent vision stratégique, créativité et technologies avancées pour accompagner les organisations à façonner des parcours clients performants, centrés sur l’humain, et accélérer leur transformation.
Notre Opportunité : 
Au sein de notre équipe, 50 consultants spécialisés sur les sujets Marketing Sales & Services accompagnent les grandes entreprises internationales sur le cadrage et la conduite de projets de transformation majeurs.
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Consultant Senior en Customer & Business Transformation F/H. Vous serez amené à conduire des projets de définition de stratégies marketing, de construction de la relation client de demain ou encore de digitalisation de l'expérience client, en collaboration avec toutes les équipes transverses d’EY (Experience Design, Analytics, IT, Strategy…)
Vos principales responsabilités 
Au sein de nos équipes vous participez à des missions visant à :
• Cadrer des projets d'envergure de transformation CRM, E-commerce et Marketplace :
- En tant que senior, je décrypte les nouveaux standards de l’expérience client et je cadre des besoins métiers
• Développer une stratégie marketing pour nos clients :
- En tant que senior, je rédige des plans marketings et lance de nouveaux produits, offres et services
• Accompagner nos clients sur des sujets nouveaux et innovants (Gen AI, Sustainability & Digital) :
- En tant que senior, j’apporte des éclairages sur des innovations, j’organise et anime des ateliers d'identification de cas d'usage métiers que je décline en feuille de route
• Piloter de grands projets internationaux de bout en bout du cadrage jusqu’à l’implémentation :
- En tant que senior, je conduis des activités et fournis des livrables clients en autonomie
• Participer au développement commercial de l’équipe et de l’entreprise :
- En tant que senior, je réalise des propositions commerciales pour des prospects et suis à l’écoute d’opportunités chez mes clients
Vos Compétences pour réussir : 
• Expérience significative d’au moins 2 ans en Conseil avec une expertise digitale forte, à la fois stratégique, technologique et centrée client.
• Niveau d’anglais courant (oral et écrit)
• Une expérience sur les sujets CRM ou data est un plus.
Ce que nous recherchons : 
• Formation supérieure de haut niveau (grande école d’ingénieurs ou grande école de commerce)
• Une personne dynamique et dotée d'un excellent sens relationnel
• Une capacité d’adaptation à des environnements variés face à des interlocuteurs de comité de direction
• Un très bon sens du service client
• Avoir de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse
Ce que nous vous offrons : 
• Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
• Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY
• L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
• Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.
• De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris..
Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.
Processus de recrutement : 
Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. Lors des entretiens métiers, nous vous proposerons également un exercice d’étude de cas ou market sizing à réaliser in situ.
Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.
EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

The opportunity
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to support Finance Transformation projects, helping clients improve how finance operates, reports and delivers value. You will work across finance processes, operating models, reporting, and digital finance initiatives, contributing to both analysis and delivery.
Working closely with French speaking clients and stakeholders, you will play a key role in driving collaboration and project execution. This role is suited for a structured and analytical professional who wants to grow at the intersection of finance, technology and transformation.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant, you will contribute to the design and delivery of Finance Transformation projects by:
• Analyzing current-state finance processes, identifying pain points and assessing opportunities for simplification, standardization and efficiency improvements.
• Contribute to the design of future-state finance processes, governance models and service delivery structures, developing practical recommendations that enhance finance performance, controls, reporting and operational effectiveness.
• Preparing key project deliverables, including process documentation/mapping, assessments, business cases, transformation roadmaps and executive presentations.
• Supporting implementation activities and helping ensure the successful adoption of new processes, tools and ways of working.
• Monitoring project risks, dependencies and action plans, escalating issues where appropriate.
• Collaborate with client stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams through workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, validate findings, build alignment and support successful project delivery. 
Skills and attributes for success
• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related field.
• 3-4 years of relevant experience supporting finance transformation or process improvement initiatives within consulting or SSC/GBS environment.
• Strong communication skills in English and French, both written and verbal.
• Good understanding of core finance processes, ideally with exposure to at least two areas such as transactional finance (R2R, P2P, O2C), FP&A, Controlling or Management/Financial reporting.
• Experience preparing presentations, process documentation, reports, dashboards, executive summaries or transformation materials.
• Strong track record of successful project delivery and client management in complex and global environments.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with stakeholders across different functions, geographies and seniority levels, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Good command of Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint and Excel; experience with Visio, draw.io or other process mapping tools is a plus.
• Relevant certifications such as Lean Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt) are considered an advantage.
Ideally you`ll also:
• Demonstrate interest in digital finance topics such as ERP platforms, reporting tools, automation, analytics, process mining, Generative AI or Agentic AI is considered a plus
• Possess exceptional communication, presentation, and people skills.
What we look for 
More than anything, we’re interested in people with the right attitude for the job! That’s naturally innovative people that feed on the energy of a thriving global team. You’ll need a balance of technical and analytical skills, a creative approach to work and strong communication skills. Put simply, if you’ve got big ideas on how we can do better, as well as the confidence to express them, this role is for you.

• Contribute to the design of transformation solutions covering operating models, processes, organizational capabilities, governance, technology enablement, performance management, and ways of working.

• Take ownership of assigned deliverables and ensure that outputs are insightful, data-driven, implementable, and consistently high quality.
