jd_text:
Business Transformation Senior Consultant
(Transportation Sector & more)
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. In un contesto in cui l'intelligenza artificiale sta ridefinendo il modo di lavorare, crediamo che il vero valore nasca dalla capacità delle persone di interpretare la complessità, costruire relazioni di fiducia e trasformare le opportunità tecnologiche in impatto concreto per clienti, organizzazioni e società. 
Perché candidarsi in EY? 
 Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti: 
• 
Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto. 
• 
Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita. 
• 
Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali. 
• 
Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta; 
• 
Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente. 
• 
Un network internazionale su cui poter contare. 
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi? Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un Business Transformation Senior Consultant in ambito Road&Transportation in EY!
 Nello specifico, ti occuperai di: 
• Supportare nell’analisi e nel ridisegno di processi, procedure e definizione di modelli organizzativi e operativi dei clienti;
• Effettuare attività di benchmark e analisi di mercato su operatori di mercato nazionali e internazionali;
• Supportare nel processo di ideazione e sviluppo di use cases su servizi innovativi, dalla fase concettuale fino all'implementazione;
• Eseguire analisi e design di nuovi KPI di business e di processo;
• Effettuare attività di analisi dati per monitoraggio delle performance ed identificazione di tendenze/opportunità
• Svolgere attività di PMO, pianificazione e governance di progetti, definendo report e presentazioni di SAL operativi e direzionali
• Guidare i consulenti junior, favorendo un ambiente collaborativo e orientato alla crescita
Per cominciare, cerchiamo un professionista senior che abbia: 
• Esperienza 2-3 anni in primarie società di consulenza o in società operanti nel settore delle infrastrutture, trasporti, logistica, multiutilities;
• Aver preso parte in progetti di PMO, digital transformation, business process design;
• Utilizzo di programmi come Microsoft Excel, Word, Power Point, Power BI per la creazione di report e dashboard dinamiche e interattive;
• Ottime capacità di comunicazione e relazione interpersonale;
• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale, in modo collaborativo, virtuale e indipendente;
• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione e con scadenze ravvicinate, gestendo le priorità in modo efficace;
• Ottima conoscenza di italiano e inglese.
In EY potrai: 
• Accelerare le tue competenze: Grazie a corsi e programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro, utilizzando tecnologie smart e applicazioni AI che ti liberano dalle attività ripetitive: da Copilot365 al tool proprietario EYQ, passando per PowerBI 
• Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: Lavora in team internazionali, disponendo di un network di professionisti globali 
• Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno. 
Avrai infine l’opportunità di: 
• accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati; 
• partecipare a programmi di leadership. 
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 32.000€ e 44.000, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. 
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico: 
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva. 
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in. Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99. 
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno. 
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world 
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo un Team di oltre 9.000 persone, distribuite in 20 città in tutta Italia. 
Crediamo fortemente nella creazione di valore a lungo termine, attraverso una crescita economica che sia inclusiva e sostenibile per tutti, dai colleghi ai clienti, dall'ambiente alla società.

Are you passionate about sustainability and thrive in solving challenging tasks that directly contribute to a better environment and society? Do you enjoy working with financial sector in supporting their sustainability ambitions and challenges? Join our growing Climate Change and Sustainability Services Team as part of a wider Assurance Advisory team within EY!
The world is facing one of the biggest challenges of humankind – constant changing of climate under today’s way we conduct economic activities. Climate change is no longer a distant sustainability concern but an immediate and systemic risk. Increasingly severe physical impacts (such as extreme weather events, resource scarcity, and infrastructure damage) combined with accelerating regulatory and market transitions are forcing governments and companies to fundamentally adapt their strategies, moving away from business-as-usual models.
When the financial services industry works well, it creates growth, prosperity, and peace of mind for hundreds of millions of people. No other industry touches so many lives or shapes so many futures. At EY Financial Services, we share a single focus — to build a better financial services industry, not just for now, but for the future.
Sustainability is at the heart of our EY brand. It is at the heart of our strategy, what we value and measure and what we do every day with our clients and within our own business. We are proud to be advocates of change to make businesses across the world more sustainable because we believe in long-term value. Delivering sustainable long-term value in Financial Services means new strategies, a new approach to managing risks, new products and services and new ways of engaging stakeholders.
Opportunity
We are looking for a high performing Consultant to join our Climate Change and Sustainable Services team dedicated to Financial Services. You will join a rapidly growing team of climate change and sustainability practitioners globally, with your base in Zurich, Switzerland, embracing a unique opportunity to make a real difference. You will be working on market leading projects, building networks, and consulting on key strategic issues in sustainable finance.
There is a wide range of exciting projects that you will be able to get involved in, across banking, insurance, pensions, wealth and asset management and private equity. You will work with clients at all levels to deliver first-class services helping them navigate the rapidly evolving sustainability agenda. Topics we cover include:
• Sustainable Finance regulatory developments and requirements by the financial sector from the EU regulatory side (such as CSRD, EU Taxonomy and SFDR) and Swiss regulatory side (such as RBI, FINMA requirements and AMAS, SBA, SIA self-regulations);
• Reporting and disclosure, including the application of ESRS, ISSB, TCFD, GRI, TNFD and other frameworks;
• Sustainable finance and net zero strategies, such as transition plans, for financial services;
• Climate change metrics and targets, greenhouse gas reporting, including the SBTi, Greenhouse Gas Protocol and PCAF;
• Responsible, sustainable and impact investment strategies and implementation;
What We Look For
• You have an agile, growth-oriented mindset. What you know matters. But the right mindset is just as important in determining success. We’re looking for people who are innovative, motivated, committed, can work in an agile way and keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
• You are curious and purpose driven. We’re looking for people who see opportunities instead of challenges, who ask better questions to seek better answers.
• You are inclusive. We’re looking for people who seek out and embrace diverse perspectives, who value differences, and team inclusively to build safety and trust.
Your Key Responsibilities
• Delivery of projects to our clients on a wide range of sustainability topics we work on, such as Regulation implementation, Sustainability Reporting & Assurance engagements for our clients from financial services organizations.
• Create innovative commercial insights for clients, adapt methods and practices to fit operational team and cultural contexts, and contribute to thought leadership.
• Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency on projects and internal initiatives, consistently driving projects to completion making sure that the work delivered is industry leading.
• Working closely with colleagues, create a positive learning culture.
• Contribute to the development of EY capabilities in technical areas and engage with clients regarding the application of these methodologies to their businesses.
• Collaborate with colleagues outside of CCaSS to deliver multi-disciplinary and cross-geographical work.
Skills And Attributes For Success
As Consultant within the team, you will be exposed to a range of assurance and advisory work in direct exchange with the clients. It is therefore essential that you bring the competencies that will allowing you to do so:
• High motivation and shared values for sustainability, social matters, governance-related topics and finance;
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills;
• Familiarity with AI topics and tools (e.g., data analytics, generative AI) and the ability to leverage them in a consulting context;
• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written;
• Strong interpersonal skills;
• Ability to manage multiple deliverables in parallel projects;
• Ability to work effectively in team-oriented, multi-cultural environment.
Qualifications
We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds, but are particularly interested in individuals that have the following qualifications:
• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, economics, environmental sciences or related fields of study;
• Internship or experiences within ESG, sustainable finance environment or climate risk, ideally focusing on advisory/consulting, assurance in financial institutions or in consulting firms;
• Ideally experience in projects in the field of non-financial information and/or integrated reporting, assurance of non-financial, ESG data (as ESG specialist / Investor Relation department, controlling, financial reporting etc) or as an external consultant. Good knowledge of SDGs, GHG-accounting, PCAF, carbon foot printing or Life Cycle Analysis is a plus
• A keen interest in, and understanding of ESG as it relates to financial services (banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, and/or private equity)
• Interest in and understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and their application to sustainability, reporting, and financial services transformation
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a pragmatic approach to problem solving, dynamic working style, well organized and structured
• A demonstrated capacity to take initiative, overcome challenges and work collaboratively through relevant work or project experience;
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in German and English, French is a plus

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Gemeinsam die Welt jeden Tag ein bisschen besser machen. Für diesen Anspruch setzen wir bei EY alles in Bewegung und gehen als Team „all in“. Schließlich haben wir ein klares Ziel vor Augen: nachhaltigen Wert und Wachstum zu schaffen – für unsere Mandant:innen, Mitarbeitenden und die gesamte Gesellschaft. Unser globales Netzwerk aus rund 400.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit bietet dir alle Möglichkeiten zu wachsen, dich zu entwickeln, dich zu spezialisieren sowie deine Stärken und Interessen beruflich zu verfolgen. Wir glauben daran, dass der richtige Karriereweg so individuell ist wie du.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres bundesweiten Teams wirst du Kund:innen aus den Bereichen Public Sector (Bund, Land, Kommune) und deren kritische Infrastrukturen durch lösungsorientierte Beratungen in die digitale Zukunft führen. Du erschaffst moderne und sichere Lösungen für Millionen von Menschen und schaffst damit täglich Mehrwert für Gesellschaft und Öffentlichkeit in Deutschland und Europa. Dafür suchen wir kluge Köpfe, kreative Macher:innen, IT-Gurus, Organisationstalente, Analytiker:innen und Vordenker:innen. In unserem Team wirst du vielfältige Aufgaben übernehmen, darunter:
• Du unterstützt die Planung, Konzeption, Steuerung und Umsetzung von Transformationsprojekten im öffentlichen Sektor oder in Bereichen mit besonderen Sicherheitsanforderungen.
• Du unterstützt Ministerien, Behörden und anderen Einrichtungen der öffentlichen Hand oder kritischer Infrastrukturen mit innovativen Methoden bei ihren Aufgaben zur Umsetzung von digitalen Transformationsprojekten.
• Du bist Teil eines Teams zur Beratung in Kundenprojekten, um Informationsflüsse und IT-Landschaften tragfähig und nachhaltig zu planen und umzusetzen.
• Du wendest klassische Managementmethoden an oder begleitest und coachst unsere Kund:innen bei der Einführung agiler Methoden wie Scrum und SAFE oder innovativer Technologien. Du übernimmst dabei sukzessive die fachliche Führung von Teammitgliedern.
• Du unterstützt uns dabei, Prozesse und Systeme der öffentlichen Verwaltungen oder kritischen Infrastrukturen in Bezug auf Cyber-Sicherheit in ganzheitlichen Ansätzen resilient zu gestalten und Regelungen zu Compliance, Regulatorik und Datenschutz als Advisor umzusetzen, um ihre digitale Souveränität zu gewährleisten.
Dein Skillset
• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master).
• Du hast Erfahrung und Interesse an der Gestaltung von Transformationen und Digitalisierung.
• Du verfügst über Reisebereitschaft und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (mindestens C1-Niveau).
Dein Mindset
• Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
• Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
• Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.
Bei EY leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.

jd_text:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
The opportunity: your next adventure awaits
You will be part of EY’s global Digital Health Excellence Center (DHEC). Our mission is to improve health outcomes and patient experiences. As the DHEC, we bring our expert knowledge and delivery power to healthcare clients in collaboration with the local firms. As part of the Swiss firm, you will focus on the Swiss market, and leverage EY’s international expertise to bring value to our local clients.
As a Senior Consultant in Digital Health, you will work alongside a team of national and international experts in technology, business and the healthcare sector. Strategy, IT-driven business transformations, and implementation of digital health solutions in Switzerland are core areas for us. With you we want to further strengthen our expertise and impact the Swiss healthcare market.
Your key responsibilities
• As a Senior Consultant in digital health, you will play an active role in our go-to-market activities, business development, and the delivery of projects for healthcare clients.
• You will develop and maintain materials representing our Swiss healthcare practice and its offering, ensuring that they reflect industry trends, best practices, emerging technologies, and market developments.
• You will maintain and grow your professional network, and build lasting client relationships together with the team, ensuring that our engagements create tangible value for our clients and contribute to the digital transformation of the Swiss healthcare landscape.
• You will work closely with healthcare, business and technology experts to align solutions with market needs, ensuring that offerings are patient-centric and take relevant healthcare standards and regulatory requirements into account.
What we look for
• An excellent academic background, including at least a bachelor’s or a master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. nursing, medicine, medical informatics, clinical IT, or digital health).
• A minimum of 3 - 4 years of relevant working experience, including experience in contributing to multidisciplinary and/or international teams and working with different stakeholder groups. Experience as a healthcare professional or in adjacent fields is a plus.
• A good understanding of the Swiss healthcare landscape and the ability to connect clinical, regulatory, business and technology requirements.
• Experience with or familiarity with healthcare-specific digital solutions (e.g. HIS, EHR, CDR, LIMS, CDSS) as well as interoperability standards and healthcare data models and terminologies (e.g. HL7 FHIR, openEHR, OMOP, LOINC, SNOMED)
• Fluency in English and at least one Swiss local language (written and spoken) is a prerequisite. Knowledge of additional languages is a plus.
• Strong organizational and self-management skills, combined with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with business, technical and/or medical audiences. Project management experience and familiarity with relevant delivery methodologies are a plus.
What’s in it for you
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skills you need to stay relevant today and, in the future, – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.
Click here to find out more about our benefits and corporate social responsibility.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jd_text:
Our Strategy and Transactions (SaT) team works with clients to manage their capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increased returns. As part of a global team of 10,000 professionals in 100 countries you will advise clients on preserving, optimising, raising or investing capital. Major groups (or, as we call them, sub-service lines and competencies) within SaT include Mergers and Acquisition Services, Valuation and Business Modelling, Project Finance, Restructuring Services, Operational Transaction Services, Transaction Support and Transaction Tax.
We are seeking to build on recent successes and continue to grow the origination and execution capacity of the team through the recruitment of a SaT professional at the Senior Associate level.
The opportunity
Leveraging an extensive global network, our SaT team provides sector-focused advice to navigate complexity by helping them to reimagine their eco-systems, reshape their portfolios and reinvent themselves for a better future. As part of this team you may also advise C-suite executives and boards on evaluating strategic alternatives in the context of transactions.
We work across all industries and operate in a broad range of disciplines including:
• Merger and acquisition as well as transaction evaluation
• Valuation, business modelling and economics
• Transaction due diligence
• Strategic planning and capital allocation
• Budgeting, forecasting and planning
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate within SaT team, you will:
• Perform industry and company research utilising online tools and publicly available information 
• Analyse the financial and operational results of companies targeted by reviewing accounting records and participating in interviews with management
• Prepare analyses of historical and pro forma financial information to assess trends and fluctuations that may impact cash flow requirements and deal valuation
• Deliver financial modeling engagements for strategic planning, capital allocation, transaction support, investment appraisal, financial planning and reporting purposes
• Perform business valuation for transaction and financial reporting purposes
• Work effectively as a team member by demonstrating your commitment to quality, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress. 
• Assist in researching technical accounting issues to evaluate implications on transaction valuation and structuring 
• Assist in preparing reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other parties
• Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel 
Skills and attributes for success
• Strong numerical, financial and modelling skills based on a well-developed understanding of financial statements
• Advanced written and verbal communication skills
• Strong Excel skills
• Ability to conduct analysis, research and reporting to interpret, validate and reconcile complex data
• Intellectual curiosity
• Dedicated, innovative, resourceful, analytical and able to work under pressure
• Foster an efficient, innovative and team-oriented work environment
To qualify for the role you must have
• A bachelor’s degree preferably majoring in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or other financial related background
• Minimum of 2 years of work experience in similar industry. Audit experience is an advantage.
• Strong numerical, financial and modelling skills based on a well-developed understanding of financial statements
• Sound commercial judgment and an ability to generate creative solutions to problems
• A passion to provide high quality service to your clients
Ideally, you’ll also have
• Professional qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CFA.
What we look for
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident leader equipped with strong people management skills and a genuine passion to make things happen in a dynamic organization. If you’re ready to take on a wide range of responsibilities, and are committed to seeking out new ways to make a difference, this role is for you.
What working at EY offers
EY offers a competitive remuneration package commensurate with your work experience, where you will be rewarded for your individual and team performance. We are committed to being an inclusive employer and are happy to consider flexible working arrangements (FWA), as needed, guided by our FWA Policy. Plus, we offer:
• Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
• Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
• Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
• Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jd_text:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Dann komm dorthin, wo beides zusammenläuft: Bei EY-Parthenon begleitest du CEOs, Vorstände und Private-Equity-Gesellschaften bei transaktionsbasierten Transformationen vom ersten strategischen Gedanken bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Deal Management & Execution-Teams in Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart oder München begleitest du komplexe Geschäftstransformationen – von Carve-outs über Post-Merger-Integration bis hin zu Joint Ventures – und gestaltest Transaktionen jeder Größenordnung aktiv mit. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
• Du entwickelst Carve-out- oder Integrationsstrategien und planst sowie setzt diese detailliert über alle Unternehmensbereiche hinweg um.
• Du unterstützt alle Transaktionsschritte im Schulterschluss mit den verschiedenen Funktionsbereichen der EY Parthenon, einschließlich der Analyse von Zielunternehmen, der Partnersuche, der Due Diligence, der Erstellung von Investorenpräsentationen, der Verhandlungen, des Vertragsabschlusses sowie der Planung und operativen Umsetzung sowohl auf der Sell- als auch auf der Buy-Side.
• Du betreust unsere nationalen und internationalen Kund:innen als Teil funktionaler sowie sektororientierter Teams.
• Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen, um Herausforderungen zu meistern und dabei deine eigenen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Dein Skillset
• Du hast dein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder anderen quantitativen Studiengängen erfolgreich abgeschlossen und interessierst dich für die Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung.
• Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Strategie-, Transaktions- oder der Restrukturierungsberatung gesammelt – alternativ bringst du Strategieentwicklungs- oder erste Transaktionserfahrungen aus der Finanz- oder Corporate-Welt mit und warst auch schon im Ausland tätig.
• Du hinterfragst Fakten kritisch und besitzt sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office (insbesondere MS Excel und PowerPoint).
Dein Mindset
• Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
• Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
• Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.

Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.

Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:

• Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen, um Herausforderungen zu meistern und dabei deine eigenen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

• Du hast dein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder anderen quantitativen Studiengängen erfolgreich abgeschlossen und interessierst dich für die Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung.
• Du hast 2-3 Jahre praktische Erfahrungen in der Strategie-, Transaktions- oder der Restrukturierungsberatung gesammelt – alternativ bringst du Strategieentwicklungs- oder erste Transaktionserfahrungen aus der Finanz- oder Corporate-Welt mit und warst auch schon im Ausland tätig.
• Du hinterfragst Fakten kritisch und besitzt sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office (insbesondere MS Excel und PowerPoint).
Dein Mindset
• Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
• Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
• Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Die Gelegenheit: Dein nächstes Abenteuer wartet
Wir helfen Dir, in einem global vernetzten Powerhouse aus vielfältigen Teams erfolgreich zu sein – und Dich in Deiner Karriere genau dorthin zu bringen, wo Du hin möchtest.
Dich fasziniert die Finanzindustrie, und Du möchtest gerne unterschiedliche Sektoren und Firmen im Rahmen von spannenden, strategischen Projekten kennenlernen?
Du arbeitest im Bereich Financial Services in unserer EY-Parthenon (EY-P) Practice.
Innerhalb von EY-P bietet unser Strategy & Transaction Execution Team ein umfassendes Portfolio strategischer Beratungsleistungen – darunter Unternehmensstrategie, Geschäftsmodell- und Zielbetriebsmodell-Design, M&A-Integrationen, Trennungen und Transformationen. Unser Team arbeitet funktionsübergreifend und begleitet unsere Kunden über den gesamten Strategie- und Transaktionszyklus hinweg. Zu unseren Kunden gehören renommierte Firmen aus der Banken-, Wealth & Asset Management sowie der Versicherungsbranche.
Bei EY-P geht es um mehr als nur einen Job. Durch unsere Arbeit ermöglichen wir es unseren Kunden nachhaltig erfolgreich zu sein. Starte jetzt Deine sinnstiftende Karriere und werde Teil unseres einzigartigen EY-P Strategy & Transaction Execution Teams, um täglich spannende strategische Herausforderungen zu lösen!
Deine Hauptaufgaben
Als Teil unseres schnell wachsenden EY-Parthenon Strategy & Transaction Execution Teams mit Fokus auf Financial Services Kunden arbeitest Du eng mit C-Level-Führungskräften der Finanzbranche zusammen, um strategische Herausforderungen zu meistern, agile Transformationsprozesse voranzutreiben und strategische Unterstützung im gesamten M&A-Lebenszyklus zu bieten.
Dabei übernimmst Du vielfältige und spannende Aufgaben:
• Strukturierung und Analyse komplexer Geschäftsprobleme
• Durchführung von Primär- und Sekundärforschung
• Erstellung von Finanzmodellen zur Bewertung strategischer Auswirkungen
• Kommunikation und Präsentation von Lösungen gegenüber internen und externen Stakeholdern
• Aktive Beteiligung an Projektakquisitionen und Publikationen
• Beitrag zum Team- und Community-Building leisten
Was wir suchen
• Bachelor, Master oder PhD in Banking, Finance, Management, Economics oder Naturwissenschaften
• Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Finanzdienstleistungen und/oder Beratung bei führenden Institutionen
• Hervorragende akademische Leistungen und relevante Berufserfahrung
• Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz
• Klarer und überzeugender Kommunikationsstil
• Unternehmerisches und leistungsorientiertes Mindset
• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse – weitere Sprachen sind von Vorteil

Hier bei EY hast du die Chance, eine wirklich aussergewöhnliche Erfahrung zu machen. Wir statten dich mit der neuesten Technologie aus und umgeben dich mit leistungsstarken Teams.Durch unsere Coaching- und Schulungsprogramme entwickelst du die notwendigen Fähigkeiten und baust gleichzeitig ein Netzwerk aus Kollegen, Mentoren und Führungskräften auf, die dich auf deinem Weg bei EY und darüber hinaus unterstützen.

jd_text:
EY-Parthenon est un des leaders mondiaux du conseil de direction générale en matière de stratégie, de transformation et de transaction. Nous réunissons 25 000 consultants à travers le monde, intégrés à notre réseau de 400 000 professionnels EY dans 150 pays. De la conception à l’exécution de vos stratégies et de vos transactions, EY-Parthenon vous aide à redéfinir votre futur.
Nos équipes apportent un éclairage extérieur et des savoir-faire précis, combinant des expertises multisectorielles et multidisciplinaires approfondies, avec des capacités de pointe en matière d'analyse de données, d'IA et de technologie.
Nous accompagnons ainsi les directions générales et leur comité de direction, les conseils d'administration, les fonds d'investissement et les gouvernements à chaque étape de leurs réflexions et de leurs prises de décision, pour les aider à façonner leur avenir en toute confiance.
Vous cherchez de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles et êtes attirés par le conseil en transaction ? L’équipe TSE (Transaction, Strategy & Execution) d’EY-Parthenon recrute pour son bureau parisien. Nous accompagnons nos clients pour maximiser la valeur dans le cadre d’acquisitions, cessions ou de retournement.
L’opportunité :
Nous conseillons nos clients (Corporate, fonds d’investissement, institutionnels) sur des transactions de premier plan. Notre équipe de professionnels issus de divers secteurs dispose d'une forte expérience en M&A, nous permettant d'apporter à nos clients une expertise sectorielle et opérationnelle reconnue sur le marché
Notre offre de service est structurée de la façon suivante : 
• Buy & Integrate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations d’acquisition en apportant une expertise approfondie sur les volets IT et technologiques, incluant le design de modèles opérationnels cibles, l’évaluation de la préparation au Day-1, l’identification et le chiffrage des synergies, ainsi que la définition et l’exécution de la stratégie d’intégration post-fusion (PMI). Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à l’achat afin d’évaluer les performances passées et actuelles de la cible, d’identifier les risques IT, et d’estimer les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Sell & Separate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations de cession en apportant une expertise IT et technologique, notamment à travers la définition du modèle opérationnel cible au Day-1, l’identification et l’évaluation des synergies, ainsi que la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de carve-out IT. Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à la vente pour présenter les niveaux d’imbrication des systèmes, évaluer les performances IT passées et actuelles, identifier les risques, et valoriser les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Product & Technology Diligence : nous réalisons des missions de diligence produit et technologique pour des entreprises à forte composante logicielle. Cela inclut l’évaluation des capacités produit, des roadmaps, de l’architecture logicielle, de la dette technique, ainsi que de l’organisation et des processus associés aux équipes de développement logiciel.
Notre équipe à Paris - actuellement en phase de forte croissance - recrute des consultants seniors H/F pour continuer à servir au mieux nos clients et soutenir notre ambition actuelle. 
Vos missions :
En tant que membre clé de l’équipe, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de nos missions. Vos responsabilités incluront notamment :
• Analyser la documentation transactionnelle et conduire des entretiens afin d’identifier les enjeux et risques critiques liés à l’IT, à la technologie et au business dans le cadre d’une opération envisagée.
• Réaliser des analyses techniques et traduire les résultats en impacts IT et financiers, tout en étant capable de les présenter à un public non technique.
• Contribuer aux projets d’intégration post-fusion (PMI), de carve-out IT, ainsi qu’au design et à la mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles (Target Operating Models - TOM).
• Encadrer et accompagner les membres Juniors de l’équipe.
Profil recherché :
• Diplômé d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en IT, technologies ou management de l’innovation appréciée.
• Minimum de 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle.
• Solides capacités d’analyse et de synthèse.
• Bonne compréhension des concepts IT et intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies.
• Une expérience en transaction, en stratégie IT ou en projets de transformation IT est un plus.
• Capacité d’adaptation aux nouveaux challenges/concepts.
• Capacité et volonté de voyager dans le cadre des missions.
• Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais. 
L’offre EY-Parthenon :
Vous bénéficierez d’un régime de rémunération et de bonus compétitif, établi sur la base de votre performance et de votre contribution à nos activités. Par ailleurs, EY-Parthenon vous permettra de : 
• Développer de nouvelles compétences et accélérer votre carrière chez un des leaders du conseil en transaction et transformation
• Travailler dans un environnement international, avec de fortes opportunités de mobilité en interne
• Bénéficier de l’accompagnement et du coaching d’une équipe d’experts reconnus sur le marché
Vivez l’expérience EY, Rejoignez-nous !
Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

jd_text:
EY-Parthenon est un des leaders mondiaux du conseil en matière de stratégie, de transaction et corporate finance. Nous réunissons 25 000 consultants à travers le monde, afin d’accompagner nos clients à chaque étape de leurs réflexions et de leurs prises de décision, pour les aider à façonner leur avenir en toute confiance.
Au sein de l’équipe Transaction Strategy & Execution (TSE), nous sommes partie prenante d’un réseau mondial de spécialistes des transactions qui fournissent des conseils de haute qualité à nos clients qu’ils acquièrent, cèdent ou réorganisent des entreprises.
L’opportunité
L’équipe TSE d’EY-Parthenon travaille sur les transactions les plus complexes, auprès d’un large portefeuille de clients et de secteurs industriels, dans le cadre de plans d’intégration et/ou de séparation. Nos talents viennent de diverses industries, ont une forte expérience en gestion de projet et sont des conseillers avisés en transactions. Cela nous permet d'apporter à nos clients une expertise sectorielle et fonctionnelle tout au long du cycle de vie de la transaction, que ce soit en amont du processus, lors des phases de due diligence, ou en phase de préparation et/ou exécution du Day-1 avec pour souci d’assurer la continuité de l’activité de nos clients.
Notre équipe à Paris - actuellement en phase de forte croissance - recrute des Consultants Seniors F/H pour continuer à servir au mieux nos clients et soutenir notre ambition actuelle.
Vos missions
En tant que Consultant Senior (F/H), vous serez un membre clé de l'équipe exécutant des projets axés sur les opérations. Vous travaillerez sur des projets couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie d'une transaction, notamment :
• Intégration / PMI (Buy & Integrate): nous accompagnons les plans stratégiques de croissance externe de nos clients, qu’ils soient réalisés via fusions et acquisitions, JV (joint-ventures) ou alliances. Nous aidons les entreprises à affiner leur stratégie d'intégration post-fusion (PMI), à identifier et à évaluer les synergies opérationnelles, à mener des buy-side due-diligences, à concevoir des modèles opérationnels cibles, à définir et exécuter les plans d’intégration au Day-1.
• Séparation / Carve-out (Sell & Separate): nous menons des programmes de cession approfondis, allant des due-diligences à l'exécution du processus de séparation (carve-out). Dans ce contexte, nos missions consistent à identifier les complexités de la séparation, établir des modèles opérationnels, évaluer les coûts de séparation et les dysynergies et fournir une assistance globale dans l'exécution des plans de séparation.
Compétences pour réussir
• Esprit entrepreneurial – Travailler dans un environnement dynamique et passionnant avec un sens aigu des affaires pour générer de la valeur pour nos clients.
• Développement Commercial – Aider dans les aspects des poursuites, y compris les présentations et les réunions avec les clients. Contribuez à nos initiatives de développement de la pratique, en soutenant l'accent continu mis sur notre équipe en tant qu'endroit où il fait bon travailler.
• Développement Personnel – Apprendre et développer des compétences techniques et personnelles pour soutenir la réalisation des objectifs de carrière, grâce à un mélange d'apprentissage structuré, de coaching et d'expériences.
• Créer des relations interpersonnelles – Créer de solides relations de travail avec les clients seniors, y compris l'influence, les conseils et le soutien aux décideurs clés.
Profil recherché
• H/F diplômé(e) d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieur
• Vous avez à minima 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en conseil, fonds d’investissement ou en milieu industriel (gestion de projet avec une à deux expertises opérationnelles fortes)
• Fortes capacités d’analyse et esprit de synthèse
• Capacité d’adaptation aux nouveaux challenges/concepts
• Capacité et volonté de voyager dans le cadre des missions
• Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais.
L’offre EY-Parthenon
Vous bénéficierez d’un régime de rémunération et de bonus compétitif, établi sur la base de votre performance et de votre contribution à nos activités. Par ailleurs, EY-Parthenon vous permettra de :
• Développer de nouvelles compétences et accélérer votre carrière chez un des leaders du conseil en transaction et transformation
• Travailler dans un environnement international, avec de fortes opportunités de mobilité en interne
• Bénéficier de l’accompagnement et du coaching d’une équipe d’experts reconnus sur le marché
Vivez l’expérience EY-Parthenon, Rejoignez-nous !
Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY-Parthenon étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
The opportunity
EY-Parthenon’s unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity.
With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, Boards, Private Equity and Governments every step of the way – enabling you to shape your future with confidence.
Within EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution sub service line, the Commercial Strategy practice works on the most complex and high-profile commercial strategies, global transactions, and turn-arounds, across a broad portfolio of clients and industry sectors. We are a group of experienced industry professionals with a background in strategy & commercial operations who are strategic advisers, which enables us to bring a wealth of deep sector and functional knowledge to our clients. As a team, we prepare and execute separation and integration strategies and plans, identify ways to maximize stakeholder value through customer and revenue opportunities, as well as advise on risk mitigation and the successful transformation of operations, functions, and people.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate/Consultant with EY-Parthenon's Strategy and Execution Commercial Strategy practice, you will be a vital member of the team leading and executing strategy development, transactions, and turn-arounds for our clients. You'll collaborate with our EY Parthenon team members to realize improved returns for clients by identifying and unlocking value through improvements in corporate/BU strategy, go-to-market strategy (including digital), commercial operating model, and optimization of the commercial functions (sales, service, marketing, pricing), while minimizing customer disruption. You will identify, define, quantify, and realize sustainable value through revenue enhancement and cost and margin improvement tied to the commercial aspects of the clients’ business.
Skills and attributes for success
• Project Management – actively participate in project teams comprising of colleagues from across EY-Parthenon to successful project execution.
• Business and Commercially Driven – work effectively in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
• Business Development - assist in aspects of pursuits and proposal development and contribute to our practice development initiatives.
• Learning - learn and develop technical and interpersonal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and project experiences.
• Building Relationships - cultivate strong working relationships with clients and EY-Parthenon team members.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or Analytics and 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
• MBA is preferred.
• Management consulting experience.
• Experience in the following:
• Corporate and/or BU strategy development.
• Commercial functions (e.g. sales, marketing, customer service, pricing).
• Go-to-market strategy and revenue synergy design/capture for traditional, digital and hybrid commercial models.
• Evaluation of market landscape including market size, competition, market trends and resulting commercial implications.
• Pre-deal strategy including growth assessments (e.g. profitability assessments, clean room, etc.).
• Excellent analytical skills and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.
• Demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.
• The ability to prioritize effectively on projects and the skills to adapt quickly to new challenges and concepts.
• Solid negotiation and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.
• The expectation for this role is in person teaming, at client site or in an EY office, a minimum of 60% of the time or on average 3 days a week over the course of an engagement, project or performance year.
• You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
• The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
• A proven record of excellence in a transactions and/or commercial strategy role.
• Experience gained within another large professional services organization.
• Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
• Established networking skills in a relevant industry.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
• We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $130,000 to $205,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
• Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Today’s deals are no longer just about ‘putting capital to work’, but especially about smart performance improvement opportunity and value creation and the role technology can play to develop attractive investment cases.

You will act as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, shaping technology strategies that drive value creation across the deal lifecycle. This role requires strategic thinking, deep technology expertise, and strong leadership to manage multiple workstreams and teams in an international environment.

• Lead strategies and transactions, including IT due diligence, carve-out planning, integration roadmaps, and post-deal transformation.
• Overseeing pre-deal and post-deal IT workstreams while managing relationships with client stakeholders 
• Advise C-level executives on technology implications of M&A, including operating model design, ERP strategy, IT architecture, and digital transformation opportunities.
• Oversee multiple engagements simultaneously, ensuring quality delivery, risk management, and alignment with client objectives.
• Support business development, including proposals, RFP responses, and go-to-market initiatives for Technology M&A services.
• Collaborate across EY service lines to bring integrated solutions to clients, leveraging sector insights and technology expertise.

Your team
You will join our fast-growing, market-leading Technology M&A team, which combines deep sector knowledge with technology expertise. Our team thrives on collaboration and innovation, supported by a culture of continuous learning and development.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
• Master’s degree in IT, Business Administration, or related field.
• 4-6 years of relevant experience in technology strategy, IT transformation, and M&A programs, ideally in top-tier consulting or large corporates.
• Proven experience with large-scale IT integration/separation programs.
• Deep knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP, MSD), IT architecture, and business processes.
• Good understanding of data management and infrastructure (network, cloud, workplace)
• Expertise in operational aspects of M&A: TSA design, stranded cost analysis, Day 1/Day 2 readiness, and technology landscape evaluation.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Fluent in English and Dutch.
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
• A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
• You’ll receive a contract for 40 hours.
• A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
• 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.
• With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
• At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
• The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
• The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
• You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
• Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
• A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
• All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself.
Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets. 
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow. 
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories

Our Media Value Creation team works with investors and executives across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization to identify, quantify, and realize value creation opportunities.
We help clients unlock value through commercial excellence, go-to-market transformation, revenue growth, pricing and monetization optimization, audience and customer expansion, operating model improvements, and transaction-related value creation initiatives. Our teams work across the transaction lifecycle and beyond, supporting management teams as they execute strategies designed to drive measurable EBITDA growth, accelerate revenue performance, and create long-term enterprise value.
Your key responsibilities
As a Senior Associate-Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution Value Creation practice, you will be a vital member of the team executing operational focused projects. You will work on projects that span the entire lifecycle of a transaction, including operational and commercial due diligence where we focus on EBITDA upside and operational risk; buy side carve out and integration planning to ensure a newly spun out business can stand alone and a merger quickly realize and grow anticipated synergies; post-acquisition 100 day and value creation planning; ongoing performance improvement; and exit readiness planning to inform an optimal strategy for maximizing returns and ensuring the buyer is well positioned to continue to enhance value.
You will also contribute to commercial value creation initiatives for Media investors and management teams across subscription, advertising, sponsorship, ticketing, content monetization, rights and licensing, distribution, and audience engagement revenue streams.
Skills and attributes for success
• Media Industry Knowledge – interest in Media and an understanding of relevant business models, value drivers, growth opportunities, and competitive dynamics across Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, and Audience Monetization.
• Project Management – be part of project teams comprising colleagues from across the Strategy and Transactions sub service lines.
• Business and Commercially Driven – working in a fast-paced, exciting environment with strong business acumen to drive value to our clients.
• Business Development – assist in aspects of pursuits, including presentations and client meetings. Contribute to our practice development initiatives, supporting the continued focus on our team as a great place to work.
• Learning – learn and develop technical and personal skills to support achievement of career goals, through a blend of structured learning, coaching and experiences.
• Building Relationships – strong working relationships with senior clients, including influence, advice and support to key decision makers.
• The expectation for this role is in person teaming, at client site or in an EY office, a minimum of 60% of the time or on average 3 days a week over the course of an engagement, project or performance year.
To qualify for the role, you must have
• A bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Marketing, Media Studies, Communications, Sports Management, or Entertainment Management and 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.
• Strategy and operations management consulting experience.
• Excellent analytical, problem solving/modeling skills, and the confidence to translate complex data into meaningful insights.
• Experience in operational or commercial due diligence, operational restructuring, value creation, and performance improvement.
• Experience in business integrations, divestitures, and/or carve-outs with a demonstrated aptitude for quantitative and qualitative analysis.
• Experience supporting value creation, commercial transformation, go-to-market, revenue growth, pricing, monetization, or performance improvement initiatives.
• Understanding of financial statements and operational performance metrics, including the relationship between commercial initiatives, EBITDA improvement, and enterprise value.
• Experience working in complex business environments.
• The ability to prioritize effectively on projects and the skills to adapt quickly to new challenges and concepts.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, and the ability to develop long-lasting relationships both internally and externally.
• You must either reside in or be in a commutable distance to your office location for this position.
• The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary. In certain circumstances, travel may be required beyond your work location based on client and project needs.
Ideally, you will have
• Experience working with, advising, or conducting strategic or commercial analysis of one or more of the following Media sub-sectors: Studios, Content & IP, Sports, Live Entertainment, Streaming, Digital Media, Advertising, Rights & Licensing, Distribution, Audience Monetization, or related Media sectors.
• Understanding of Media business models and value drivers, including subscription, advertising, sponsorship, content monetization, ticketing, rights and licensing, audience engagement, and distribution economics.
• Experience conducting analyses related to audience acquisition, customer retention, pricing, advertising, sponsorship, subscription growth, content commercialization, rights and licensing, ticketing, or distribution.
• Experience supporting go-to-market strategy, revenue operations, sales effectiveness, marketing effectiveness, pricing, customer acquisition, or commercial operating model initiatives.
• Experience evaluating and quantifying value creation opportunities through transaction-related, commercial transformation, or performance improvement initiatives.
• An understanding of how Media companies create and monetize intellectual property, audiences, rights, content, experiences, and distribution channels.
• Experience translating industry trends, changing consumer behaviors, and evolving monetization models into strategic, commercial, or operational implications.
• A proven record of excellence in a transactions, strategy, commercial, or analytical role.
• Experience gained within a Media company, investment organization, corporate strategy function, or large professional services organization.
• MBA or other relevant graduate degree is preferred.
• Dynamic individuals who thrive in ambiguous situations to help clients solve their most critical strategic, business, and economic challenges.
• Knowledge of how to leverage firm-approved AI tools in a business setting, including Microsoft Copilot.
What we look for
We’re interested in talented professionals with the ability to visualize our clients’ goals and think creatively to facilitate them.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and commercial problem-solving capabilities with a genuine interest in Media industry growth drivers. They are energized by evaluating opportunities, developing data-driven insights, and helping investors and management teams accelerate commercial performance, improve profitability, and create measurable enterprise value.
If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and a genuine passion for helping Media businesses navigate complex strategic, commercial, and operational challenges, this role is for you
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
• We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $130,000 to $205,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
• Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
• Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
EY-Parthenon supports companies in making investments for organic or acquisitive growth and improvements. This includes strategy development, operational transformations, restructurings, and guiding IPOs, mergers, and acquisitions. By combining the broad knowledge and experience within our team with analytical tools and techniques, and working closely with the global EY-Parthenon network, we help clients make well-informed decisions. We then assist organizations in turning strategy, transactions, or transformations into reality. Our team culture is built on training, entrepreneurship, and creative freedom.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a senior consultant, you’ll be part of the EY-Parthenon Strategy & Execution team, with a focus on People Strategy. Your focus is on advising and supporting clients throughout the entire deal life cycle, providing a range of People and HR-related services on both the sell-side and buy-side. We contribute to and validate the deal price pre-deal and assist in realizing deal synergies post-deal.
You will contribute to the following activities:
• Complex HR due diligence, day-one readiness, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and post-deal value creation such as strategic workforce planning, organization design, employee relations planning and execution, and culture, communication &change initiatives.
• Supporting clients in planning and implementing People and HR elements for organizational restructuring programs at both strategic and operational levels.
• Addressing People and HR-related matters through all stages of acquisition, divestiture, and merger, including pre- and post-deal.
• Writing and reviewing reports, project planning, data analysis, and developing presentation materials. Additionally, analyzing (financial) data and presenting high-quality, risk-managed reports, including client and executive presentations.
• Structuring and managing (international) projects that meet and exceed client expectations, while confidently and effectively recognizing and managing potential issues during client assignments.
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
The People Strategy and M&A team works with clients to manage their employee capital agenda to drive competitive advantage and increase returns on investments. As part of a global team of professionals in 100 countries, you will advise clients on preserving, optimizing, raising, or investing capital.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
A background in Finance is not required, but affinity with this discipline and familiarity with financial terminology is important. We invite recent graduates with a Master’s degree from a Dutch university in: Strategy, Business Administration, Finance, Organizational Studies, Econometrics, HRM, or similar to apply.
• Experience in advising clients on a range of transactions and restructurings, ideally in People topics, is a plus.
• In addition to your studies, you have developed yourself in various ways, such as through a relevant internship, a board year, or other extracurricular activities.
• You have strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and are highly proficient in both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
• You have a strong and demonstrable affinity with People and HR topics, strategy development, and mergers & acquisitions in a broad sense.
• You are highly experienced with Microsoft Office and Excel. If required, you already hold a valid work permit.
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
• A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
• You’ll receive a contract for 40 hours.
• A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
• 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days.
• With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
• At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
• The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
• The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
• You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
• Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
• A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
1. For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
2. Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 5 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.
3. First interview: Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have.
4. Second interview: If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow.
5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!
Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

jd_text:
KPMG’s Pricing strategy practice is a specialised team focussed on solving pricing and revenue optimisation problems for its clients’ using data and analytics techniques to deliver a sustainable solution which can deliver both short- and long-term margin improvements. As a team, we are a group of bright committed individuals who are passionate about delivering fantastic client work, solving complex data related problems, investing our time in acquiring new analytical skills, and having fun both inside and outside of work.
We are recruiting for a Consultant with Pricing, Data Analytics and Python experience. The role is currently part of KPMG’s Pricing Strategy team based in India that works closely with KPMG UK and includes following core responsibilities:
 • Working collaboratively with client staff and management, often working in joint teams and sometimes at client sites, in the development and delivery of pricing solutions/ recommendations.
 • Understand client system and data structures and designing and executing data intensive analysis to support development of evidence-based insights.
 • Independently work on analysis, including defining deliverables, setting timelines, and develop high quality output and managing expectations.
 • Implementation of solutions/tools in client environment and train client to implement new approach and appropriate tools.
 • Planning and undertaking primary and secondary research to develop insightful analysis for clients.
 • Contributing to the delivery and presentation of client deliverables
 • Being involved in business development activity, showing initiative in building relationships with clients during engagements and while at client site
 • Contributing to thought leadership and knowledge management to support practice development.
• Education/professional qualifications: MBAs/ B. tech/ B.E. from a leading Indian/International educational institutions
 • Strong experience (at least 2-3 years) with strategy or analytics experience gained in corporate roles, analytic boutique, and strategic consultancy firms.

education: Educational qualifications
jd_text:
#KGS 
The KPMG Global Services (KGS) Deal Advisory & Strategy (DA&S) team offers advisory support across deal life cycle space and provides services on aspects preceding and succeeding a deal. Our service networks assess deal demands by carrying out due diligence both from the buy-side and the sell-side perspectives. 
The team of over 1,700 professionals boasts proven capabilities in various sectors, such as financial services, consumer markets, healthcare and life sciences, energy and natural resources, industrial markets and TMT, 
addressing clients’ needs to resolve complex transactional and strategic challenges.
Through your work, you’ll build a global network and unlock opportunities that you may not have thought possible with access to great support, vast resources, and an inclusive, supportive environment to help you reach your full potential.
•Support strategy engagements across commercial and operational due diligence, growth strategy, value creation and performance improvement
•Apply hypothesis-led problem solving to structure ambiguous client questions and translate them into clear analytical workplans
•Conduct commercial and market analysis, including market sizing, customer and competitor assessment, business-model analysis, competitive benchmarking, survey analysis and strategic-fit evaluation
•Analyse client, market, financial and operational data to identify revenue-growth, cost-optimisation and broader value-creation opportunities, including across supply chain, procurement, manufacturing and back-office functions
•Work with structured and unstructured datasets, alongside primary and secondary research and stakeholder interviews, to test hypotheses and develop fact-based insights
•Develop business cases, financial analyses, business plans, strategic roadmaps, go-to-market strategies and success KPIs to evaluate and support strategic initiatives
•Lead workstreams and analyses on engagements, coordinating team inputs and taking responsibility for small teams where required
•Synthesise complex quantitative and qualitative findings into clear insights, practical recommendations and high-quality reports and presentations, delivered within agreed timelines
•Collaborate closely with onshore KPMG teams in developing analyses, recommendations and client deliverables, while proactively communicating progress and emerging issues
•Support business development through proposals and contribute to thought leadership and knowledge management
Educational qualifications
•MBA from a recognised institution, preferably with a specialisation in strategy, finance, marketing, operations or a related discipline
Work experience
•2–5 years of relevant experience in strategy consulting, with exposure to one or more of commercial due diligence, operational due diligence, growth strategy, value creation or performance improvement
